[EN] I'll reward anyone who kills {@LinkCreature:39#190#ferocious maligoses}.

Those wretched demons cut my people to ribbons. They're tough and nasty, I won't lie to you.

Think you're up to the challenge?
[ES] Recompensaré a cualquiera que mate a los {@LinkCreature:39#190#ferocious maligoses}.

Esos malditos demonios hicieron pedazos a mi gente. Son duros y desagradables, no te voy a mentir.

¿Crees que estás a la altura del desafío?

[EN] Fine work! With those maligoses dead, maybe we'll have fewer nightmares around here.
[ES] ¡Buen trabajo! Con esos maligoses muertos, tal vez tengamos menos pesadillas por aquí.
